text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian Orthodox Church celebrated the 30th anniversary of its independence. Ceremony attended by president Kiro Gligorov and Prime Minister Branko Crvenkovski.
- Market prices continue to rise, some went up two to three times more than the devaluation rate.
- "Russia wants constructive relations with Macedonia and understands its desire to become a NATO member," said Macedonian Defense Minister Lazar Kitanovski on his return from Moscow.

- Ethnic Albanian PDP party discussed the future of its coalition with the ruling SDSM after the Gostivar events ten days ago. PDP expected to ask for resignation of interior minister Tomislav Cokrevski, unofficial sources say.
- President of the Democratic Party of Albanians Arben Dzaferi said that the DPA would not give up struggling for Albanian rights although it is labelled as an extremist party in Macedonia.
